displayPattern: LED behind the blower-door view port on a York TG9S. Each flash is 1/3 second on and 1/3 second off, then a 2-second pause: 6 red flashes
meaning: While the furnace was operating, the pressure switch opened four times during the call for heat. The furnace locks out for one hour and then restarts.
diySteps: Look at the outdoor vent pipe for a blockage. The one-hour lockout is not a repair
Technician: check the inducer, the vent pipe and the pressure switch
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician if 6 red flashes return after the vent pipe is confirmed clear.
